+def test_collection_redirect_and_package_initializers(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mocker):
+    roots = {}
+    for name in ('alpha.one', 'beta.two'):
+        root = tmp_path / name.replace('.', '/')
+        root.mkdir(parents=True)
+        roots[name] = root
+        package = ModuleType('ansible_collections.' + name)
+        package.__path__ = [str(root)]
+        monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, package.__name__, package)
+
+    utils = roots['beta.two'] / 'plugins' / 'module_utils'
+    (utils / 'pkg' / 'deep').mkdir(parents=True)
+    (utils / 'cousin').mkdir()
+    (utils / '__init__.py').write_bytes(b'ROOT = 1\n')
+    (utils / 'new.py').write_bytes(b'from .pkg import VALUE\n')
+    (utils / 'pkg' / '__init__.py').write_bytes(b'from .sub import VALUE\nfrom ..cousin.sub import OTHER\n')
+    (utils / 'pkg' / 'sub.py').write_bytes(b'VALUE = 2\n')
+    (utils / 'cousin' / 'sub.py').write_bytes(b'OTHER = 3\n')
+    (utils / 'pkg' / 'deep' / 'mod.py').write_bytes(b'ANSWER = 42\n')
+    metadata = {
+        'alpha.one': {'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {
+            'old': {'redirect': 'beta.two.new'},
+            'oldpkg': {'redirect': 'beta.two.pkg'},
+        }}},
+        'beta.two': {},
+    }
+    mocker.patch.object(module_common, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=lambda name: metadata[name])
+
+    output = BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as zf:
+        recursive_finder('test', 'ansible_collections.alpha.one.plugins.modules.test',
+                         b'from ansible_collections.alpha.one.plugins.module_utils import old\n'
+                         b'import ansible_collections.alpha.one.plugins.module_utils.oldpkg.sub\n'
+                         b'import ansible_collections.beta.two.plugins.module_utils.pkg.deep.mod\n',
+                         set((('ansible', '__init__'), ('ansible', 'module_utils', '__init__'))), {}, zf)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output) as zf:
+        prefix = 'ansible_collections/beta/two/plugins/module_utils/'
+        assert b'ansible_collections.beta.two.plugins.module_utils.new' in zf.read(
+            'ansible_collections/alpha/one/plugins/module_utils/old.py')
+        assert b'ansible_collections.beta.two.plugins.module_utils.pkg.sub' in zf.read(
+            'ansible_collections/alpha/one/plugins/module_utils/oldpkg/__init__.py')
+        assert zf.read(prefix + '__init__.py') == b'ROOT = 1\n'
+        assert zf.read(prefix + 'pkg/__init__.py').startswith(b'from .sub import VALUE')
+        assert zf.read(prefix + 'pkg/sub.py') == b'VALUE = 2\n'
+        assert zf.read(prefix + 'cousin/sub.py') == b'OTHER = 3\n'
+        assert zf.read(prefix + 'cousin/__init__.py') == b''
+        assert zf.read(prefix + 'pkg/deep/__init__.py') == b''
+        assert zf.read(prefix + 'pkg/deep/mod.py') == b'ANSWER = 42\n'

+def test_locator_precedence_and_routing_metadata(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mocker):
+    local = tmp_path / 'legacy'
+    local.mkdir()
+    (local / 'old.py').write_bytes(b'LOCAL = True\n')
+    collection_root = tmp_path / 'collection'
+    (collection_root / 'plugins' / 'module_utils').mkdir(parents=True)
+    (collection_root / 'plugins' / 'module_utils' / 'old.py').write_bytes(b'COLLECTION = True\n')
+    package = ModuleType('ansible_collections.alpha.one')
+    package.__path__ = [str(collection_root)]
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, package.__name__, package)
+    routing = {'old': {'redirect': 'beta.two.new', 'deprecation': {
+        'warning_text': 'Use new', 'removal_version': '3.0', 'removal_date': '2030-01-01'}}}
+    mocker.patch.object(module_common, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={
+        'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': routing}})
+    warning = mocker.patch.object(module_common.display, 'deprecated')
+
+    legacy = module_common.LegacyModuleUtilLocator(('ansible', 'module_utils', 'old'), mu_paths=[str(local)])
+    assert legacy.source == b'LOCAL = True\n'
+    assert not legacy.redirected
+    collection = module_common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(
+        ('ansible_collections', 'alpha', 'one', 'plugins', 'module_utils', 'old'))
+    assert collection.redirected
+    assert b'ansible_collections.beta.two.plugins.module_utils.new' in collection.source
+    warning.assert_called_once_with('Use new', version='3.0', date='2030-01-01', collection_name='alpha.one')
+
+    routing['old'] = {'tombstone': {'warning_text': 'Gone', 'removal_version': '3.0'}}
+    with pytest.raises(ansible.errors.AnsibleError, match='Gone.*alpha.one.*3.0'):
+        module_common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(
+            ('ansible_collections', 'alpha', 'one', 'plugins', 'module_utils', 'old'))
